alarms.description: Transmembrane pressure exceeds safe operating limit (TMP > 45 kPa)
alarms.actionRecommendation: Initiate air scour boost; reduce train flux by 15%; schedule Maintenance Clean (MC)

alarms.description: Transmembrane pressure exceeds emergency membrane strain threshold (TMP > 60 kPa)
alarms.actionRecommendation: Automatic trip of train permeate pump to prevent fiber collapse; switch train to relaxation/cleaning
Check coarse aeration airflow; inspect MLSS viscosity, temperature drop, or extracellular organic shock

alarms.description: Normalized permeability has dropped below economic threshold (Lp_20 < 100 LMH/bar)
alarms.actionRecommendation: Schedule NaOCl chemical maintenance clean to remove pore foulants
Take train offline for intensive recovery Clean-In-Place (CIP with NaOCl + Citric Acid)

alarms.description: Membrane coarse bubble air scour flow below minimum shear velocity (< 750 Nm3/h)
alarms.actionRecommendation: Check blower discharge valve, blower VFD trip, or diffuser line header check-valve
Increase WAS sludge wasting rate; check RAS recirculation flow from membrane tank

alarms.description: Aerobic biological tank DO is dangerously depressed (< 1.2 mg/L)
alarms.actionRecommendation: Increase biological fine bubble blower speed; prevent filamentous bulking and nitrification loss
Suspected membrane fiber rupture or header seal leak; isolate train permeate line and conduct pressure decay test (PDT)

alarms.description: TMP pressure transmitter signal frozen / flatline detected
alarms.actionRecommendation: Inspect transmitter diaphragm; purge impulse line for sludge blockage

alarms.description: Chemical cleaning permeability recovery below target (< 70%)
alarms.actionRecommendation: Inspect cleaning chemical concentration; check pH; switch chemical or consider dual acid-hypochlorite clean
